item.title: FreeXR status update #1
item.dc:creator: ThatOSDeveloper
item.description: FreeXR has currently had a few things done, first of all we released the (now patched, at least we think) root exploit for the Meta Quest 3(s), once again, PLEASE run this command with adb to disable updates on your device (YOU WILL LOSE THE ABILITY TO ROOT IF YOU UPDATE!) the root IS NOT PERMANENT! AND IS LOST ONCE YOU REBOOT! PLEASE DO NOT CLICK INSTALL IF YOU HAVE MAGISK!

item.title: About FreeXR
item.dc:creator: ThatOSDeveloper
item.description: FreeXR is a project that plans to port linux, openXR/stardustxr, and the full linux userspace to VR headsets like the Quest 3/3s.
